page.layout: One column of running text, with one marginal note in the right margin beside "facta est mentio". Running head above the text, page number at the head, catchword and signature at the foot.

main_text.p: majórem gradum, secundum hujus enim intentionem & augmentum generátur morbi calidi: hujus generis sunt piper, zinziber, & similia linguam acriter vellicantia.
Vel humectando & emolliendo, ut Spinachium, Beta, Malua, Mercurialis, cau-lis capitatus & id genus alia culinis nota.
Veldetergendo, viscosofque humores visceribus adhærentes eluendo, ut succus ab-sinthii[?], aristolochiæ, centaurii minoris, sabinæ, gentianæ, agrimoniæ, dracunculi, hellebori, ari, falisq; liquor.

Velaftringendo, hoc est, meatus, venarumq; ac arteriarum ora coarctando, ut succus tormentillæ, cotoneorum, prunorum fyluestrium, pyrorum fyluestrium, malorum granatorum, citriorum, arantiorum acidorum, aliaque plura, quorum facta est NB[?]mentio interincrallantia[?]: & certum est magnas hic strui vitæ insidias: difficile enim est à blandissimis suauissimisque malorum quorundam nostratium & exoticorum, ut citriorum & arantiorum, succis sibi temperare, quibus multi porcorum more saginam explent, unde postea insignem corporis alterationem sustinere & perpeti coguntur: alii enim succi sunt prædulces, alii acidi, alii austeri, acerbi alii, quidam vero ex horum multis vel duobus temperati sentiuntur. page.notes: The right-margin mark beside "mentio" is read as "NB" with doubt; its shape is unclear. "fimthii" at the line break is read as "absinthii" from the context "ab-". "fabi-næ" is read as "sabinæ". "interincrallantia" and "hominiä" are doubtful readings, kept as printed with [?]. The page number "36ı" is read as 361. The long s is normalised to plain s throughout. Some small marks at the right edge of the text block are not legible enough to transcribe.
